post.description: Preview the submitted tagged edit without receipts, controls or reservations.
Evaluate persisted UTC endpoints, including ended windows, without rescheduling.

get.description: Bounded sanitized diagnostics; never a per-delivery status API.

202.description: All items acknowledged by Kafka; eventual PostgreSQL application is not guaranteed.

207.description: Mixed acceptance, validation rejection or unconfirmed publication. Retry failed members only.

422.description: All members failed validation, or legacy metadata was invalid.

503.description: Admission dependency/deadline failure, or no member was acknowledged and at least one publication failed. Acknowledgement uncertainty may leave Kafka duplicates.
